title: Implement KV cache hit/miss counters + miss reason taxonomy in serving runtime
creator: Omar El-Sayed
description:
Goal
Implement low-overhead KV cache hit/miss counters + miss reason taxonomy in the serving runtime. This is the core instrumentation needed by dashboards/alerts and the recommendations MVP.

Scope (this ticket)
- Add counters for KV cache lookup outcomes across request lifecycle (prefill/decode) with stable semantics.
- Add miss reason taxonomy (initial set) and ensure it’s safe/stable for dashboards.
- Add minimal supporting histograms needed for reuse effectiveness (if not already covered by prefix-cache ticket).
- Unit tests + one integration test that exercises repeated prompts to validate hit attribution.
- Validate overhead and ensure instrumentation is disabled/sampled by default in prod until canary passes.

Non-goals
- Changing eviction policy / cache algorithm.
- High-cardinality labels (tenant, raw route names, prompt hashes) in runtime metrics.

Metric semantics (implementation intent)
- A “hit” is counted when the runtime reuses existing KV cache entries for the current request such that prefill work is avoided for some prefix tokens (as defined in ADR via ENG-4821).
- Partial reuse counts as a hit for the reused portion; we will also emit reused_tokens to allow effectiveness calculations.
- Streaming retries: do not double-count hits/misses across retry attempts for the same logical request. (Requires idempotent attribution per request_id/attempt semantics.)

Proposed metric names (final names may be reconciled by ENG-4821 standards doc)
Counters (monotonic):
- redwood.cache.kv.lookup_total{result=hit|miss, miss_reason?}
- redwood.cache.kv.reused_tokens_total
- redwood.cache.kv.prefill_tokens_total
- redwood.cache.kv.wasted_prefill_tokens_total (if gated here; otherwise tracked in separate PR)
Gauges (optional):
- redwood.cache.kv.enabled (0/1) [internal debug only; ok if removed later]

Miss reason taxonomy (initial)
Keep set small + stable:
- capacity (no space / allocation failure)
- ttl_expired
- policy_disabled (per-route or global)
- hash_mismatch (canonicalization differences / prompt differs)
- version_mismatch (model/version incompatibility)
- unknown (fallback; should be rare)

Acceptance criteria
- [ ] New counters exported via existing metrics pipeline with <1% p95 latency regression at default sampling in perf-canary.
- [ ] Unit tests cover:
  - hit + partial hit accounting (reused_tokens)
  - miss reason mapping does not panic and is stable
  - streaming retry does not double-count
- [ ] Integration test drives repeated prompts and asserts increasing hit counts / reused tokens under cache-enabled config.
- [ ] Metrics are behind feature flag(s) / sampling knob(s) and default to conservative sampling in prod.
- [ ] Review sign-off from Runtime (Omar / Sofia) + Telemetry schema owner (Nadia) on metric naming/labels.

Implementation notes
- Prefer structured enum for miss reasons to avoid stringly-typed churn.
- Do not attach high-cardinality labels in runtime. Route/model/version context is added in ENG-4823 / ENG-4826 wiring; runtime should only expose the core signal.
- Use per-request accumulation to avoid per-token metric calls in hot loops. Emit counters once at end of prefill/decode boundary (or request completion) where possible.
- Ensure batched prefill path attributes hits correctly per request (known footgun with continuous batching).

Links
- Linear parent definitions/tags: ENG-4821

comments: 2025-03-04 (Omar El-Sayed): Marking P0 for sprint. Please keep label set minimal; anything route/tenant/model must be handled via allowlists at gateway/ingestion. Runtime should export core signals only.

2025-03-05 (Samir Qureshi): Drafted counters + reused_tokens accumulator. Plan: store per-request CacheStats {reused_tokens, prefill_tokens, lookup_result, miss_reason} and emit once per request end. Avoid per-token increments in hot loops.

2025-03-06 (Nadia Rahman): Miss reason enum looks good. Please ensure 'unknown' exists and is used rather than dropping label value. Also ensure miss_reason label only present when result=miss; otherwise leave unset to avoid weird aggregations.

2025-03-07 (Marcus Reed): Perf note: emitting metrics at request completion is preferred, but watch for streaming where completion can be far from prefill. If you emit at prefill end, make sure you don’t later re-emit on completion. We should not add contention on shared counters in the decode loop.

2025-03-10 (Samir Qureshi): Opened PR #18421 adding lookup_total(hit/miss) + reused_tokens_total + prefill_tokens_total behind feature flag runtime.cacheTelemetry.enabled. Included unit tests for partial hit accounting. Still need retry semantics test.

2025-03-11 (Noah Patel): Review: partial hits should count as hit if reused_tokens>0. But ensure reused_tokens_total increments by exact reused prefix length, not by cached blocks count. Also be careful when the request is served from a different worker after retry; request_id/attempt must be used to dedupe.

2025-03-12 (Samir Qureshi): Added dedupe guard keyed by (request_id, attempt) so we only emit lookup_total once per attempt. Follow-up PR #18428 handles streaming retries by recording a stable logical_request_id propagated through retry path; metrics emit only for the first attempt unless retry changes miss_reason from policy_disabled->hit (we decided not to do that; keep first outcome).

2025-03-13 (Sofia Ivanova): Confirmed scheduler path for continuous batching: batched prefill can reuse KV for multiple requests; hit attribution must be per-request based on actual reused tokens. Please add regression test for batched prefill before merge.

2025-03-14 (Samir Qureshi): PR #18433: fix hit attribution under batched prefill; we were using batch-level reused_tokens. Now compute per-request reused prefix length from per-seq KV cache state. Added unit test that simulates 2 sequences in same batch with different reuse depths.

2025-03-16 (Allison Grant): From dashboards POV, we need miss_reason breakdown stable. Please don’t rename values after merge without coordinating with ENG-4824. Also confirm 'version_mismatch' covers model version pinning mismatch (common support case).

2025-03-17 (Marcus Reed): Ran perf-canary locally: with sampling=0.05 and emit-at-prefill-end, p95 delta +0.18%, p99 +0.35% on chat mix. With sampling=1.0 (for staging), p95 +0.9% — acceptable for staging only. OK to proceed with canary gating in release plan.
2025-03-18 (Omar El-Sayed): Approved. Ensure defaults: enabled=false in prod config; sampling set via config flag introduced in ENG-4825/PR #18425. Marking Done once integration test PR is merged.
2025-03-18 (Samir Qureshi): Merged PRs #18421, #18430, #18428, #18433. Integration test merged via #18427. All checks green; ready for rollout per release checklist.
